text:
maria_cs: FYI — Zenora account weekly latency snapshot for the renewal prep. p95/p99 broken down by route + model and streaming vs sync below. Please skim before Thu sync.

eva_kim: quick paste of p95/p99 (ms) from Mon 00:00–Sun 23:59 (peak windows highlighted)
```
route   model           streaming p95 / p99   sync p95 / p99
/chat   redwood-1.3     110 / 260           220 / 580
/chat   llama-2-13b     140 / 350           320 / 820
/embed  oak-7b-ql       45  / 90            95  / 180
/rerank oak-7b-ql       70  / 160           150 / 420
```

jonah_re: wow — /chat non-stream p99 for llama-2-13b at 820ms is concerning, that can affect perceived SLAs in the renewal demo.

pat_reilly: we saw queue length spikes on the dedicated pool during the Tue peak. Increased batch_size to 16 on the llama pool to keep GPU utilization up, but that likely drove the higher p99 on non-stream.

maria_cs: noted. error-rate trend: overall error rate rose from 0.2% -> 1.1% on /chat non-stream (llama-2-13b) during Tue-Wed burst. spend +18% MoM attributed to longer token times + retries.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy (reduce-batch-size=8) completed: 2026-03-12T22:13Z — staging metric snapshot uploaded.

eva_kim: short analysis notes: streaming keeps p95 low because of early partial flushes and lower batching; non-stream accumulates tokens in batch which helps throughput but hurts tail latency for bursty traffic. For this workload we should consider smaller max_batch for chat routes on llama-2-13b or prefer redwood-1.3 as fallback for interactive demos.

jonah_re: actionables: 1) run 1-hr targeted eval in the Tue 18:00–19:00 peak window on staging for /chat with llama-2-13b (vary batch_size 4/8/16) — I'll own. ETA EOD Wed.

pat_reilly: I'll run batch_size 8 vs 4 perf on staging and post p95/p99 diffs, plus check KV cache hit rates.

maria_cs: I'll update the Zenora account health doc: note renewal risk = "medium" until we show stable p99 < 500ms on non-stream for demo routes. Also prepping fallback plan and talking points for Thu call.

eva_kim: suggested alert changes: set p99 alert threshold to 500ms for /chat non-stream, and add a rate-of-change alert for error-rate >0.5% over a 1h window.

jonah_re: acknowledged. will include a short repro script to reproduce the burst in staging.

pat_reilly: quick note — embedders (oak-7b-ql) look fine; p99 under 200ms both modes. So fallback for semantic features is low-risk.

maria_cs: schedule: Thu 11:00 PT customer call; I'll send calendar invite and agenda. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: alert: billing spike detected for Zenora — estimated +20% this billing period vs forecast.

maria_cs: flagged to finance & AE. I'll include spend mitigation options in the renewal packet.

jonah_re: I'll post the staging test logs and a short summary after the eval.

pat_reilly: will paste results and recommended batch config in thread.

maria_cs: perfect — that's everything for now.
